name: Game Boy handheld carrier — final connector correction

fabrication.reference: Frozen carrier prototype geometry and KiCad project settings; supplier process capability has not been qualified.

sources.rationale: Preserve the authored prototype: every source segment is 0.25 mm; net clearance 0.2 mm; vias 0.6/0.3 mm. Existing KiCad project requires 0.3 mm minimum hole, 0.1 mm annular ring, 0.25 mm hole-to-hole and 0.5 mm edge clearance. These are design constraints, not supplier qualification or measured hardware limits.
